meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 安装后可查询 claude-mem 与 cmem.ai Pro 的云同步状态，或把 token、user id、SyncHub URL 三个连接值写进本地设置，重启 worker 后验证。
howto.when: 当你说「set up cloud sync」「sync my memories」等，或想把记忆数据库备份、同步到 cmem.ai 账户时触发。

say.note: 查询并报告设备 id、待处理数与 Hub 连通性。

say.text: 帮我设置 cmem pro 云备份
把记忆同步到我的 cmem.ai 账户
say.note: 写入连接设置，重启 worker 后验证。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can check your claude-mem cloud sync status, or write the three connection values (token, user id, SyncHub URL) into local settings and restart the worker to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories" or "sync status", or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Reports device id, pending counts and Hub reachability.

say_en.text: Set up cmem pro cloud backup
say_en.note: Asks for the token, user id and SyncHub URL.

say_en.text: Sync my memories to my cmem.ai account
say_en.note: Writes settings, restarts the worker, then verifies.
